Is Mon 2 Nov a holiday in Mumbai?
8:32 PM

As far as I know, no. Mon 2 Nov 2026 was an ordinary working day in Mumbai, with no public or bank holiday. The Diwali holidays came later, around Sun 8 Nov to Tue 10 Nov. I can't check live holiday lists, so confirm with your bank or office if it matters.
